newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells $176 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells $176 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 9.614 billion shillings ($176 million) of treasury bills at its weekly auction, bank officials said on Thursday.
In the 91-day main category of bills, the bank sold 9.408 billion shillings at an average yield of 20.991 percent compared to 5.976 billion shillings at 21.179 percent last week.
The bank said it sold 206 million shillings in the 28-day category at an average yield of 16.500 percent unchanged.

The central bank has progressively lowered interest rates on t-bils from 24 percent in October as part of tough monetary measures undertaken to reduce punitive levels of commercial bank lending rates.
The bank invited tenders for 10 billion shillings of treasury bills for the next auction on Thursday, next week.
